description: Search the Corti di giustizia tributaria decisions (first and second grade, MEF DocTrib, post-reform only). Hybrid mode fuses full-text (italian) and vector ranking with reciprocal rank fusion. LEGAL POSTURE: the full text is never returned; each hit gives the extremes (id, tipo, grado, luogo, sezione, anno, numero, data, estremi), a short highlight or passage (headline, snippet, at most 1500 characters) and the source_url of the MEF page. Documents the MEF publishes without text exist but are not searchable (the status Tool reports their count). Parameters: query (web-search syntax), k (1..50, default 20), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters grado (1 or 2), luogo (exact, case-sensitive, e.g. Campania), anno_from and anno_to (anno_from must not exceed anno_to). At least a query or one filter is required; filters alone list the newest decisions first. Example: {"query": "avviso di accertamento motivazione", "grado": 2, "luogo": "Campania"}.
